route: Levels 1-10: finish the starter zone quickly, then talk to Chromie in your capital to choose a Chromie Time expansion.
Chromie Time spans levels 10-70 (Dragonflight is the default). Stick to one expansion's campaign instead of hopping between zones.
At 70, move to The War Within; it has an expedited story mode, and Midnight cut the XP needed for 70-79 by roughly 74%.
First character: the Midnight campaign is effectively required. Eversong Woods, then Zul'Aman, Harandar and Arator's journey, then Voidstorm (88-90).
Finishing the campaign unlocks Adventure Mode, so alts can skip the story and level through any zone, world quests or events.
Fast alt route: clear the Tier 1 delves for Delver's Call quests (big XP since 12.0.7), quest in Eversong/Zul'Aman, finish with first-time crafts.
Dungeons: do each Midnight dungeon once while you hold its quest. Spamming them only pays off with instant tank or healer queues.
Stack buffs: War Mode (+15%, level 25+), Warband Mentor (+5% per max-level alt, up to 25%), Darkmoon Faire (+10%), heirlooms below 70.

bestSpec.name: Arms
bestSpec.why: It usually quests faster than the other specs, cleaving two targets with Sweeping Strikes and healing itself with Victory Rush.

alternative.name: Fury
alternative.why: It gets multi-target tools early and has plenty of defensives. Choosing it over Arms is mostly preference.

keyAbilities.name: Charge
keyAbilities.why: Open every fight with it to close the gap instantly.

keyAbilities.name: Sweeping Strikes
keyAbilities.why: Your early cleave: single-target hits also strike a second enemy.

keyAbilities.name: Mortal Strike
keyAbilities.why: Your main single-target damage button.

keyAbilities.name: Victory Rush
keyAbilities.why: Free damage plus a heal after each kill, so less downtime.

keyAbilities.name: Die by the Sword
keyAbilities.why: Damage reduction that makes bigger pulls safe.

classes.tip: Save the big cooldowns, Colossus Smash and Bladestorm, for large packs instead of using them on every single mob.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build for Patch 12.1. Allocate it point by point as you level. Sharpen Blade is the top War Mode pick.

bestSpec.name: Retribution
bestSpec.why: Icy Veins calls it by far the fastest questing spec: strong damage everywhere plus enough healing to stay safe solo.

alternative.name: Protection
alternative.why: Very safe on big AoE pulls with near-instant tank queues, but slower against single targets.

keyAbilities.name: Judgment
keyAbilities.why: Tag several mobs with it before bursting the pack.

keyAbilities.name: Wake of Ashes
keyAbilities.why: Big AoE burst for clearing grouped enemies.

keyAbilities.name: Avenging Wrath
keyAbilities.why: Main damage cooldown for large pulls.

keyAbilities.name: Divine Storm
keyAbilities.why: Holy Power spender that hits the whole pack.

keyAbilities.name: Divine Shield
keyAbilities.why: Emergency immunity when a pull goes wrong.

classes.tip: Gather as many mobs as possible with Judgment, then open with Avenging Wrath and Wake of Ashes to wipe the pack at once.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build (Patch 12.1). The guide says War Mode talents don't speed up Ret leveling.

bestSpec.name: Beast Mastery
bestSpec.why: The pet does most of the damage and sustains itself with Leech, so you can pull big groups and tough mobs.

alternative.name: Survival
alternative.why: Simple melee spec that still leans on the pet, with a well-rounded damage profile.

keyAbilities.name: Misdirection
keyAbilities.why: Sends threat to your pet so mobs bunch up for pet AoE.

keyAbilities.name: Wild Thrash
keyAbilities.why: Your AoE button; it also keeps Beast Cleave active on the pet.

keyAbilities.name: Bestial Wrath
keyAbilities.why: Burst cooldown for pulls that will survive its duration.

keyAbilities.name: Kill Command
keyAbilities.why: Core damage; use on cooldown.

keyAbilities.name: Mend Pet
keyAbilities.why: Keeps your pet alive through large pulls.

classes.tip: Level with a Ferocity Clefthoof as your pet. Pull with Barbed Shot and Cobra Shot, then Wild Thrash, Bestial Wrath and Kill Command once the mobs are stacked.

talents.notes: The guide gives a point-by-point talent tree but no import string could be found in its text. Mastery, then Crit on heirlooms.

bestSpec.name: Subtlety
bestSpec.why: Strong single-target burst and the best self-healing of the rogue specs, so you need fewer breaks to recover.

alternative.name: Outlaw
alternative.why: Very good in its own right, with strong AoE, high burst and shorter defensive cooldowns.

keyAbilities.name: Shadow Dance
keyAbilities.why: Main damage window. Your damage is weak outside it, so use it often.

keyAbilities.name: Eviscerate
keyAbilities.why: Primary single-target finisher at 5+ combo points.

keyAbilities.name: Black Powder
keyAbilities.why: Finisher for two or more enemies.

keyAbilities.name: Evasion
keyAbilities.why: Dodge most attacks for 10 seconds while you pull a big group.

keyAbilities.name: Crimson Vial
keyAbilities.why: Quick self-heal between or during pulls.

classes.tip: Use Stealth and Vanish to skip fights you don't need, and pull big only when Evasion is ready.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build (Patch 12.1). Cut to the Chase (level 18) keeps Slice and Dice up automatically.

bestSpec.name: Shadow
bestSpec.why: It's the only priest DPS spec, so it's much faster and the strongest for solo questing.

alternative.name: Discipline
alternative.why: Keeps some offense and is a good choice if you want to heal your way through dungeons.

keyAbilities.name: Shadow Word: Pain
keyAbilities.why: DoT to tag as many mobs as you can.

keyAbilities.name: Vampiric Touch
keyAbilities.why: Second core DoT for multi-target pulls.

keyAbilities.name: Tentacle Slam
keyAbilities.why: Spreads Vampiric Touch to several targets at once.

keyAbilities.name: Halo
keyAbilities.why: AoE damage on cooldown.

keyAbilities.name: Voidform
keyAbilities.why: Main cooldown for tough enemies.

classes.tip: Tag mobs with Shadow Word: Pain and Tentacle Slam and let your DoTs do the killing, using Fade and Psychic Scream to stay safe.

talents.notes: Level 80 starting talents for the Archon build (Mind Flay: Insanity and Halo). The guide also lists a Voidweaver string: CIQAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAzmBAAAAAAAAAAAwYsYGjlxYmZzMmZgBzMzYBZGLmpBwMzAABY2mNgZDAjZmhxMzMzsxMwMYGA

bestSpec.name: Blood
bestSpec.why: Icy Veins says solo players usually find Blood best: it can pull huge groups and heal through long fights.

alternative.name: Unholy
alternative.why: Rewards frequent large pulls, using Putrefy to summon lesser ghouls for burst.

keyAbilities.name: Death and Decay
keyAbilities.why: Drop it where you'll fight; it empowers your AoE.

keyAbilities.name: Death Strike
keyAbilities.why: Main self-heal; use when low or near max Runic Power.

keyAbilities.name: Blood Boil
keyAbilities.why: Spreads Blood Plague and deals AoE damage.

keyAbilities.name: Marrowrend
keyAbilities.why: Builds and maintains Bone Shield.

keyAbilities.name: Dancing Rune Weapon
keyAbilities.why: Use on cooldown for extra damage and safety.

classes.tip: Blood's self-sustain lets you pull whole areas at once, so gather big packs instead of fighting mobs one by one.

talents.notes: The guide mentions a Level 80 string, but it couldn't be extracted. Death Chain is the standout War Mode talent for multi-pulls.

bestSpec.name: Elemental
bestSpec.why: A forgiving ranged spec with strong burst, AoE and self-heals, rated the easiest fast leveler.

alternative.name: Enhancement
alternative.why: Arguably just as fast with strong sustained damage and self-healing, but harder to play well.

keyAbilities.name: Flame Shock
keyAbilities.why: Apply on pull and when you need to move.

keyAbilities.name: Lava Burst
keyAbilities.why: Core damage; cast whenever it's available.

keyAbilities.name: Stormkeeper
keyAbilities.why: Use whenever it's ready for empowered casts.

keyAbilities.name: Earthquake
keyAbilities.why: AoE for packs that will stand in it.

keyAbilities.name: Earth Elemental
keyAbilities.why: Pet tank that makes big pulls much safer.

classes.tip: Elemental is slow without cooldowns, so time your big pulls for when Stormkeeper, Ascendance and Earth Elemental are ready.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build (Patch 12.1). Mastery and Haste are the preferred heirloom stats.

bestSpec.name: Frost
bestSpec.why: Excellent kiting tools make it nearly unkillable against melee mobs.

alternative.name: Arcane
alternative.why: Best if you have very good gear from the last expansion, since it can one-shot many enemies.

keyAbilities.name: Frostbolt
keyAbilities.why: Main nuke with a heavy slow, so you can kite safely.

keyAbilities.name: Arcane Explosion
keyAbilities.why: Instant AoE for spam-pulling packs; it's mana-hungry.

keyAbilities.name: Ice Barrier
keyAbilities.why: Keep it up before pulling anything that won't die fast.

keyAbilities.name: Frozen Orb
keyAbilities.why: Strong multi-target damage once unlocked.

keyAbilities.name: Blizzard
keyAbilities.why: Ground AoE for larger groups.

classes.tip: Choose your pace: play safe with one Frostbolt target at a time, or gather packs and spam Arcane Explosion when your mana allows.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build (Patch 12.1). Frost Bomb is the top War Mode talent, and Blizzard's Starter Build also works.

bestSpec.name: Affliction
bestSpec.why: The most versatile spec: it DoTs many targets at once and bursts pulled packs down.

alternative.name: Demonology
alternative.why: About as fast, with better single-target and demon cleave, which suits small pulls and tough rares.

keyAbilities.name: Agony
keyAbilities.why: Tag mobs while moving; prioritize it over Corruption.

keyAbilities.name: Corruption
keyAbilities.why: Second DoT for softening up groups.

keyAbilities.name: Unstable Affliction
keyAbilities.why: Main spender on 1-2 targets.

keyAbilities.name: Seed of Corruption
keyAbilities.why: AoE spender for 3+ targets.

keyAbilities.name: Drain Life
keyAbilities.why: Self-sustain that keeps you going between pulls.

classes.tip: Overpull freely by tagging every mob with Agony and Corruption, and use the Voidwalker when solo to take hits.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build (Patch 12.1). Rampant Afflictions is strong in War Mode for multi-target pulls.

bestSpec.name: Windwalker
bestSpec.why: The guide's general pick for the smoothest leveling, usually the quickest through quests and story.

alternative.name: Brewmaster
alternative.why: A mobile, self-healing tank with very short dungeon queues for leveling through dungeon spam.

keyAbilities.name: Touch of Death
keyAbilities.why: Often an instant kill; use it first when available.

keyAbilities.name: Fists of Fury
keyAbilities.why: Heavy channeled damage that hits groups.

keyAbilities.name: Rising Sun Kick
keyAbilities.why: Core high-damage strike.

keyAbilities.name: Spinning Crane Kick
keyAbilities.why: Main AoE for pulled packs.

keyAbilities.name: Leg Sweep
keyAbilities.why: Stuns a whole group so you can AoE it down safely.

classes.tip: Follow the priority list with Touch of Death first, and use Leg Sweep on big pulls to take the pressure off.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build, redone for Patch 12.1. Turbo Fists makes big pulls easier in War Mode.

bestSpec.name: Guardian
bestSpec.why: Icy Veins' suggested leveling spec: it survives huge AoE pulls and gets fast tank queues.

alternative.name: Balance
alternative.why: Ranged DoTs and Starfall handle groups efficiently, and it's known as a very efficient leveling and farming spec.

keyAbilities.name: Thrash
keyAbilities.why: AoE damage; use whenever it's off cooldown.

keyAbilities.name: Mangle
keyAbilities.why: Main Rage generator and hard hitter.

keyAbilities.name: Ironfur
keyAbilities.why: Spend Rage on it to stay safe in big pulls.

keyAbilities.name: Frenzied Regeneration
keyAbilities.why: Self-heal when health drops below half.

keyAbilities.name: Berserk
keyAbilities.why: Damage cooldown for large groups.

classes.tip: Stay in Bear Form, gather large groups and AoE them down. Queue as a tank for near-instant dungeons.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' 'Guardian Druid Level 80 Midnight Leveling' build (Patch 12.1). Guardian is unavailable until level 10.

bestSpec.name: Havoc
bestSpec.why: It clears open-world quests fast, pulling large groups with Eye Beam and healing from Shattered Souls.

alternative.name: Devourer
alternative.why: The new Midnight spec, with very high AoE from Void Ray and good mobility, but Void Metamorphosis takes setup.

keyAbilities.name: Eye Beam
keyAbilities.why: Burst AoE on cooldown; your main pack-clearer.

keyAbilities.name: Blade Dance
keyAbilities.why: AoE spender; use on cooldown against groups.

keyAbilities.name: Felblade
keyAbilities.why: Gap-closer that also generates Fury.

keyAbilities.name: Metamorphosis
keyAbilities.why: Big cooldown; use as often as possible on tough enemies.

keyAbilities.name: Blur
keyAbilities.why: Two-charge defensive for when pulls go wrong.

classes.tip: Havoc's self-healing supports big pulls, so pull large and keep Blur, Fel Rush and Vengeful Retreat ready for emergencies.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' 'Havoc Leveling - Level 80 Starting Talents'. Take Felblade and Eye Beam first, Soul Rending adds Leech, and Fel-Scarred is the hero tree after 71.

bestSpec.name: Devastation
bestSpec.why: It does the most open-world damage, and Eternity Surge often one-shots or nearly kills enemies.

alternative.name: Preservation
alternative.why: Can be faster if you prefer dungeons, or for keeping a group alive while friends pull.

keyAbilities.name: Azure Strike
keyAbilities.why: Tags several mobs for big pulls and fills when out of Essence.

keyAbilities.name: Fire Breath
keyAbilities.why: Puts a DoT on the whole grouped pack.

keyAbilities.name: Pyre
keyAbilities.why: Uncapped AoE spender that kills big pulls together.

keyAbilities.name: Eternity Surge
keyAbilities.why: Empowered burst that hits multiple targets.

keyAbilities.name: Renewing Blaze
keyAbilities.why: Short-cooldown defensive heal that makes mass pulls safe.

classes.tip: Tag a large group with Azure Strike, apply Fire Breath, then spam Pyre.

talents.notes: Icy Veins' Level 80 Midnight leveling build (Patch 12.1). Crit and Haste heirlooms are preferred.

unverified: Midnight intro minimum level: Icy Veins says 78, but other guides start Midnight at 80.
Midnight zone level bands differ by source (Eversong 80-82 vs 80-83; branch zones 82-88 vs 83-88).
Wowhead's alt route says to avoid the campaign, but whether Adventure Mode fully skips it for alts wasn't checked against Blizzard notes.
Shaman: Icy Veins doesn't name a single best spec. Elemental comes from Wowhead's older guide (patch 10.2.7) plus Icy Veins' praise of both DPS specs.
Demon Hunter: Icy Veins says 'no wrong choice' between Havoc, Vengeance and Devourer. Havoc as best for solo questing comes from Wowhead's older guide.
Druid: Icy Veins recommends Guardian; other sites often favor Balance or Feral for solo questing.
No XP-bonus event found for October 2026. Turbulent Timeways (+30%) ran in summer 2026. Regular Timewalking runs: MoP Oct 7-14, WoD Oct 28-Nov 4.
Import strings were read through a page summarizer (each read twice, both matching), not from raw HTML. Test-import them in-game before publishing.
Beast Mastery Hunter and Blood DK: no import string found on the Icy Veins pages.
